dx_hgbl_double_hit.quote: reclassified after FISH as high-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements (double-hit lymphoma; WHO-HAEM5 category)

dx_gcb_hans.quote: GCB phenotype by Hans algorithm: CD10+, BCL6+, MUM1/IRF4 negative.

tx_plan_outdated.quote: the 2026-09-14 plan was built before FISH; both need updating to the amended diagnosis.

stage_ii_bulky.quote: Ann Arbor stage II, A (no B symptoms), bulky disease (mediastinal 12.0 cm, at least 10 cm); Lugano stage II bulky. This is provisional.

mn_stage_iii_iv.quote: marrow involvement would make it stage IV.

bio_double_expressor_secondary.quote: Double expressor by IHC: MYC 80% and BCL2 90% of tumor cells. FISH on block A2: MYC break-apart rearranged in 78% of nuclei with IGH::MYC (t(8;14)); BCL2 break-apart rearranged in 85%

prog_ipi1_biology_dominates.quote: The standard IPI scores low (age 54, ECOG 1, stage II, one factor for LDH) and must not be used to reassure: it does not capture double-hit biology.

tx_intensive_curative.quote: Do not give R-CHOP. The cycle 1 slot planned for 2026-09-22 should be replaced by DA-EPOCH-R every 21 days for 6 cycles, with CNS prophylaxis

mn_non_curative.quote: Goal is cure: he has said he wants the treatment with the best chance of cure

tx_isrt_consolidation.quote: Residual PET-avid mediastinal mass at end of treatment should prompt consolidative involved-site radiation to the mediastinum.

cns_staging_mri_csf.quote: Double-hit (MYC and BCL2) status is a recognized high-risk feature for CNS relapse, and its effect is not captured by the CNS-IPI.

cns_prophylaxis.quote: replaced by DA-EPOCH-R every 21 days for 6 cycles, with CNS prophylaxis (intrathecal methotrexate with lumbar punctures, per institutional protocol)

mn_cns_dismissed.quote: CNS-IPI scores 1 (LDH above normal only; age 54, ECOG 1, stage II, extranodal sites under 2, no kidney or adrenal involvement), which is low risk (under 1%). I would not rely on that score.

resp_pet_lugano.quote: Interim PET-CT after cycle 2 with Deauville score: if Deauville 1-3, continue; if Deauville 4-5, do not simply continue, but review with tumor board for a change of therapy or trial, since the outcome is poor. End-of-treatment PET-CT after cycle 6 by Lugano 2014 criteria.

sup_tls.quote: Tumor lysis: high clinical risk (double-hit high-grade lymphoma, bulk 12 cm, Ki-67 95%, LDH elevated, urate 7.9 mg/dL close to the 8 mg/dL threshold). Start allopurinol or febuxostat now.

sup_central_access_infusion.quote: as 96-hour continuous infusion days 1-4 via port

sup_fertility.quote: (12) Fertility counselling and sperm banking before cyclophosphamide and anthracycline.

sup_svc_airway.quote: SVC and airway emergency plan for patient and family: sleep head-elevated; call or present for stridor, worsening facial or neck swelling, orthopnea, syncope or inability to swallow liquids.

work_hbv_reviewed.quote: Hepatitis B: HBsAg and anti-HBc negative with anti-HBs positive, indicating vaccine immunity; no antiviral prophylaxis or routine HBV monitoring is needed.

work_echo_reviewed.quote: LVEF 60% with normal diastolic function, no heart disease, no prior cancer or treatment.

fit_intensive.quote: Fit for intensive therapy: age 54, ECOG 1 (2026-09-08), normal renal function (creatinine 0.9, eGFR 101), normal liver tests (2026-09-04), LVEF 60% with normal diastolic function
